text:
[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 53::Three years.
]


By a vendor of immovable property for personal payment of unpaid purchase-money.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runThe time fixed for completing the sale, or (where the title is accepted after the time fixed for completion) the date of the acceptance.
